name: Kadefy AI Chat Builder
author: Kadefy

sections.description:
Kadefy AI Chat Builder lets you add a custom AI chatbot to your WordPress website that’s trained on YOUR data – your pages, documents, and FAQs. Unlike generic chatbots, it actually knows your business.

Features:

  • One-click installation – just enter your Chatbot ID
  • AI chatbot trained on your website content
  • Customizable themes and branding
  • Lead capture forms
  • Page targeting – show the chatbot only where you want it
  • Shortcode support for manual placement
  • Works with any WordPress theme

How it works:

  1. Create your chatbot at Kadefy AI Chat Builder
  2. Train it on your website, documents, or FAQs
  3. Install this plugin and enter your Chatbot ID
  4. Your AI chatbot is live!

Plans:

Kadefy AI Chat Builder offers a generous free plan with 50 messages. Paid plans start at $9/month for more messages and features. View pricing
sections.installation:
1. Upload the kadefy-ai-chat-builder folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Kadefy AI Chat Builder
  4. Enter your Chatbot ID (find it in your Kadefy AI Chat Builder dashboard)
  5. Click “Test Connection” to verify
  6. Done! Your chatbot is now live on your site.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Chatbot ID?

Log in to your Kadefy AI Chat Builder dashboard, open your chatbot’s settings, and find the Chatbot ID in the Embed tab.

Do I need a paid plan?

No! The free plan includes one chatbot with 50 messages. You can upgrade anytime for more messages and features.

Can I show the chatbot only on certain pages?

Yes! The plugin includes page targeting. You can show the chatbot on all pages, exclude specific pages, or only show it on specific pages.

Does this work with my theme?

Yes. The chatbot widget floats on top of your site and works with any WordPress theme. You can customize colors and positioning in the Kadefy AI Chat Builder dashboard.

Is the chatbot GDPR compliant?

Kadefy AI Chat Builder includes consent options for lead capture and does not track visitors unless lead capture is enabled. See our Privacy Policy for details.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • New: Kadefy Chat now appears as its own top-level menu in the WordPress admin, instead of under Settings, so it is easier to find.
  • New: Added a “Settings” link to the plugin’s row on the Plugins page for quick access to configuration.
  • New: Added a “Getting Started” panel to the settings page that guides new users to create a free account and connect their Chatbot ID. It appears until a chatbot is connected, then collapses to a slim connected status.
  • Fix: The Chatbot Preview card now populates immediately after a successful connection test, without needing a page reload.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Chatbot ID connection and validation
  • Automatic widget injection
  • Page targeting (all, include, exclude)
  • Shortcode support
  • WordPress dashboard widget
  • Admin bar status indicator
  • Read-only chatbot config preview
